summary: Completed the initial schema-version-2 review of DLocal Limited Class A common shares after the 2026-07-31 SMA 50/200 bullish crossover. Q1 2026 TPV, revenue and gross profit grew 73%, 55% and 40% year over year, and corporate cash reached USD 451.8 million, supporting the emerging-market payment-infrastructure thesis. Offsetting evidence includes gross-profit-over-TPV compression to 0.84%, weak quarterly adjusted free cash flow, 61% top-ten merchant concentration, and material tax, foreign-exchange, regulatory, working-capital and litigation risks. The crossover was narrow, with only a 1.34% 20-session return and mixed momentum evidence. At the USD 15.08 mark, the deterministic assessment derives Hold/Watch and allocation-ineligible: base upside is 9.42%, confidence-adjusted expected return is 7.62%, bear/base payoff is 0.21 and the USD 13.20 buy zone is below the mark. No strategy or idea follow-up was created.

evidence.claim: The audited 2025 Form 20-F confirms dLocal's Nasdaq Class A listing and payment-infrastructure model, reports that the ten largest merchants represented 61% of revenue, describes non-exclusive and short-notice merchant contracts, and details emerging-market regulatory, tax, foreign-exchange, working-capital, safeguarded-funds and litigation risks.

dLocal reported Q1 2026 TPV of USD 14.1 billion, revenue of USD 335.9 million and gross profit of USD 118.7 million, up 73%, 55% and 40% year over year. Gross profit over TPV fell to 0.84%, reported net income was USD 41.9 million, adjusted free cash flow was USD 14.7 million, corporate cash was USD 451.8 million and guidance was retained.

The Q1 interim statements report USD 815.6 million total cash, USD 553.3 million equity, USD 41.9 million attributable profit and 298.5 million diluted weighted-average shares, while separately identifying large payment-settlement receivables and payables and employee-plan dilution relevant to valuation normalization.
